title: P0006 Fuel Shutoff Valve "A" Control Circuit Low
content:
P0006 Fuel Shutoff Valve "A" Control Circuit Low
OBD-II Trouble Code Technical Description
Fuel Shutoff Valve "A" Control Circuit Low
What does that mean?
The P0006 DTC code is generic, so that means it applies to all makes of vehicles. It's a very rarely seen DTC.
Symptoms
Symptoms of a P0006 DTC will include MIL (Malfunction indicator lamp) illumination, although there may be other symptoms.
Potential Causes
Well there is little to no good information on this code. The "Fuel Shutoff Valve "A" Control Circuit Low" indicates the problem may lie in the electrical circuit in the fuel shutoff valve control.
Possible Solutions
Please consult a factory service manual for more specific troubleshooting steps.
